phase_scope: 16 true decode phases; original complete route packets must be consumed and verified, prefill rows are skipped without simulation. Each decode is conditioned on its observed entry; prior full-chain exact GPU result is explicitly reused.
hypothesis: Same-plan mirror reservation or overwrite before another GPU-missing expert is claimed directly loses entry-mirror supply and contributes to the long-predecessor k1 mirror-hit deficit.
mandatory_outputs: Per-layer actual software read/mirror supply reconstructed from raw l2_clock deltas under aggregate-zero L2-hit and no-reset/overflow preconditions, with aggregate closure.
Ordered per-plan GPU miss/occupied victim projection from frozen GPU core, full GPU phase end equality, per-layer previous-baseline load identity and four disjoint decode-interval count closures.

Direct loss U=min(8,max(0,m-1),occupied victim count,missing intersect possiblemirror count); possiblemirror starts at actual decode entry and adds only strictly earlier GPU victim IDs. No task-contiguity guesses.
Sum U per layer capped by actual software read misses; group/k/phase totals and A/C S/L k1,k2,k3 contrasts, retain gains as well as losses.
Source-conditioned proofs of L2 capacity protection and no pending source-copy wait for true T=1, plus finite host counterexamples/contract checks.
Decision distinguishing direct race exclusion/admissibility from indirect history effects and unknown exposed IO/GPU/host timing.

decision_gate.target: observed S mirror_hits minus L mirror_hits within arm, separately A/C
decision_gate.if_both_arms_upper_less_than_positive_de: Reject full same-phase direct-race explanation; close this bounded mechanism stage with layer localization and explicit remaining indirect/history uncertainty, no new runtime or HTTP.
decision_gate.otherwise: Before further implementation freeze one default-off narrow observer appendix and specific affected arm; do not infer race exists or promise speed from a loose bound.
not_allowed: Claim a bound on indirect history benefit
Treat bounds as measured race frequency or speedup

diagnostic.arm_selection: A if A direct bound does not exclude full direct explanation; otherwise C only if C does not exclude it. Same explicit existing arm settings.

tool_validation: Freeze tool identity and test commands after grouped implementation/static review; run new direct host contracts once. Reuse unchanged prior55 contracts and exact baseline only within original scope. Preserve failures and target only affected repairs.
delivery: Update STATUS and append log; stage commits/push separate branch; independent result review and final protection/remote identity audit.
